settings.tuxedo_binary.label: tuxedo binary
settings.tuxedo_binary.description: Name on PATH, or an absolute path to the tuxedo executable.
settings.todo_dir.label: Todo directory (TODO_DIR)
settings.todo_dir.description: Directory holding todo.txt. Sets TODO_DIR for the CLI. The file is created on first use.
settings.todo_file.label: Todo file (TODO_FILE)
settings.todo_file.description: Optional explicit path to the todo file. When set it overrides TODO_DIR.
settings.done_file.label: Archive file (DONE_FILE)
settings.done_file.description: Optional path to the completed-task archive. Empty uses a sibling done.txt.
settings.notes_dir.label: Notes directory (NOTES_DIR)
settings.notes_dir.description: Optional base directory for a task's note:<path> tokens.
settings.refresh_seconds.label: Refresh seconds
settings.refresh_seconds.description: How often the task list is polled. Minimum 5.
settings.default_group_by.label: Default grouping
settings.default_group_by.description: How the board groups tasks when it opens (Flow = Todo / Doing / Done).
ui.title: Todos
ui.error.not_installed_hint: Install it, or set an absolute path in Settings → Plugins → Note (tuxedo).
ui.not_installed_body: Install tuxedo, or point the plugin at an absolute path in its settings.
